title: Intermittent Fasting Timer
description: A live 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 or OMAD fasting timer with progress tracking that survives page reloads.
howto: Choose your fasting plan (16:8 is the classic start).
Press Start fasting — the timer keeps running even if you close the tab.
Watch your progress toward the eating window; press End to finish early.

faqs.q: Does the timer keep running if I close the page?
faqs.a: Yes. Your start time is saved in this browser, so reopening the page shows the correct elapsed time.

faqs.q: What can I drink while fasting?
faqs.a: Water, black coffee and plain tea are generally considered fine. Anything with calories breaks the fast.

faqs.q: Is intermittent fasting safe for everyone?
faqs.a: No. It is not advised for pregnant or breastfeeding women, people with a history of eating disorders, or some diabetics. Check with a doctor first.
